spans.s:
hṛcchayá, a. lying or abiding in the
heart [1265]; as m. love, 2^19. [hṛd +
śaya, 159, 203: acct, 1270.]

hṛcchaya-vardhana, a. increasing or
arousing love.

hṛcchayā́viṣṭa, a. entered by or filled
with love. [ā́viṣṭa, √viś, 1085a: acct of
cpd, 1273.]

hṛcchayā́viṣṭacetana, a. possessing a
love-filled mind. [hṛcchayā́viṣṭa + cétanā,
1298a, 334^2.]
